description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

Delivering the best Spotify experience possible. To as many people as possible. In as many moments as possible. That’s what the Experience Mission is all about. We use our deep understanding of consumer expectations to enrich the lives of millions of users around the world, bringing the music, audio, and video they love to the devices, apps, and platforms they use every day.

This position sits at the heart of Spotify’s Content Platform, responsible for the systems that define, structure, and govern all content across the platform. Our mission is to provide a trusted, consistent source of truth so content can be reliably managed and reused across every Spotify experience. We build and operate the core systems and workflows that ensure content is accurate, complete, and available; from APIs and life cycle orchestration through to content quality and integrity.

As Spotify’s content ecosystem continues to grow in scale and complexity — across new formats, use cases, and regulatory environments — this domain plays a critical role in ensuring we scale intentionally while maintaining the trust and quality our users and creators expect.

We’re now seeking a Director of Engineering to lead this domain — shaping its technical direction, developing teams, and evolving the systems that underpin Spotify’s global content platform.

lists.content:
• Lead and develop multiple engineering teams through engineering managers, supporting their growth and impact
  • Own and drive the technical strategy for a critical platform domain, aligning with broader company and platform goals
  • Enable teams across Spotify to build product experiences efficiently by improving the underlying catalog systems
  • Guide the evolution and modernization of complex, legacy systems into scalable, reliable architecture
  • Partner closely with product and cross-functional leaders to align priorities and drive execution
  • Improve system reliability and reduce operational friction in workflows that directly impact content availability
  • Identify and apply opportunities for automation and AI to improve data quality and engineering productivity
  • Build a strong, inclusive engineering culture where teams continuously improve how they work and deliver
  • Develop and execute a long-term roadmap balancing immediate priorities with strategic investments
    •

• You have experience leading engineering organizations through other leaders and scaling teams effectively
  • You have worked on complex, data-intensive systems where accuracy, consistency, and reliability at scale are critical
  • You are confident in system design and architectural decision-making in distributed systems
  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and making trade-offs in high-pressure, high-impact environments
  • You have experience evolving legacy systems and guiding long-term platform transformations
  • You influence effectively across engineering, product, and business stakeholders
  • You have experience leading distributed teams and creating alignment across locations
  • You communicate clearly and can explain complex technical topics to a range of audiences
  • You are curious about how AI and automation can improve systems and workflows, and apply that thinking pragmatically
  • You care about building inclusive, collaborative environments where teams can grow and do their best work
    •

• This role is based in Stockholm or London
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
Backstage was created at Spotify and has grown into a leading SaaS and open source platform for developer portals. Thousands of companies use Backstage to bring structure to complex microservices environments, improve developer experience, and ship high-quality software faster — including in the age of AI — without losing autonomy or control.
This role leads sales for Shipping Our Expertise (SOE), Spotify's B2B SaaS business built on our platform capabilities. Our flagship products — Backstage Portal and Confidence — are AI-first and built to support both human developers and automated systems. Everything we bring to market is battle-tested at Spotify scale, giving our customers confidence that our solutions work in the most complex R&D environments.

  • Tell a compelling story about Spotify’s dogfooding approach and how our products are proven internally at scale

lists.content:

  • Partner with product managers and business stakeholders to build and scale our services, powering our platform.
  • Collaborate with teams and disciplines across the world to deliver high-quality, high-impact customer-facing products and features.
  • Perform code reviews, create documentation and take on complex bug fixes across services and multiple levels of the stack.
  • Improve operational excellence and share your knowledge across the company to promote best practices.
  • Work in an environment that supports your individual growth.

• You are a full-stack engineer with at least 3 years of hands-on experience in Java and TypeScript to implement end-to-end features that handle a high volume of data.
  • You have a strong understanding of web and API development principles and significant experience in building, integrating with, and using APIs. Proficiency in understanding and implementing REST, gRPC, and GraphQL is essential.

  • We are a distributed workforce enabling our band members to find a work mode that is best for them! We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home full time.

descriptionPlain:
Think it, build it, ship it, tweak it" is at the core of Spotify's product development approach. In the Experimentation product area we are providing Spotify and external customers with Confidence, our platform to quickly and safely iterate through ideas, learn from them and make informed decisions for better products.
 
At Spotify, experimentation touches almost all of our functions from marketing via content management to consumer products, and we’re running several thousands of tests every year. Through confidence, we 're sharing all our findings and practices with more companies as a commercial SaaS product.
 
The team you will manage is a skilled and highly engaged group of engineers that are distributed over Europe. As an Engineering manager, you coach them individually and as a team, maintaining their strong team culture and helping them thrive and and grow. Your technical experience provides mentorship and guidelines to the team, which ensures quality and timeliness of your deliveries. Your leadership promotes creativity, collaboration and courage, which forms a kind and productive team with a high bar for quality and pace of delivery.

descriptionPlain:
Delivering the best Spotify experience possible. To as many people as possible. In as many moments as possible. That’s what the Experience Mission is all about. We use our deep understanding of consumer expectations to enrich the lives of millions of users around the world, bringing the music, audio, and video they love to the devices, apps, and platforms they use every day.
The Content Platform team powers the full lifecycle of content across music, podcasts, audiobooks, and emerging formats. We make sure that everything—from licensed tracks to creator submissions and user-generated content—is delivered in a way that’s trusted, safe, and high quality at global scale. Our work sits at the heart of Spotify’s ecosystem, shaping how content is ingested, understood, governed, and distributed.
We’re seeking an Engineering Manager to lead a team focused on delivering content across Spotify’s ecosystem—ensuring that metadata and media flow efficiently and reliably from a wide range of internal systems to our apps and partner platforms. This work underpins every play, recommendation, and interaction, requiring systems that are scalable, observable, and resilient.

descriptionPlain:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
You’ll join the Core Value & Engagement product area within our Core Experience studio. This team builds and evolves some of Spotify’s most loved features—from Social Messaging to Wrapped and our Playlist Platform. We focus on reducing friction and helping users connect more deeply with Spotify every day. You’ll work closely with engineering, product, design, and data partners to shape engaging, high-impact user experiences at scale.

text: Engineering Manager - Core Experience (Core value and Engagement)
descriptionBody:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

You’ll join the Core Value & Engagement product area within our Core Experience studio. This team builds and evolves some of Spotify’s most loved features—from Social Messaging to Wrapped and our Playlist Platform. We focus on reducing friction and helping users connect more deeply with Spotify every day. You’ll work closely with engineering, product, design, and data partners to shape engaging, high-impact user experiences at scale.

description:
The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify’s subscription products to drive sustainable growth by improving conversion, retention, and overall user value. We create seamless, personalized experiences that make it easy for users to discover, upgrade, and stay engaged with Spotify.

Messaging Platform & Tooling is the system that decides what Spotify says to its 700M+ users — and how, when, and where it says it. Nearly every push notification, email, and in-app message flows through this platform, making it one of the highest-leverage systems at Spotify.

Within this space, the Selection squad sits at the core — acting as the decision engine that determines what message reaches each user in real time. You’ll join a high-performing, collaborative team of senior engineers and play a key role in shaping the next generation of this platform as we invest heavily in its future.

lists.content:
• Lead and support the Selection engineering team, focusing on growth, performance, and creating an environment where engineers can do their best work
  • Partner with Product, Data Science, and ML Engineering to define and deliver the technical roadmap for Selection
  • Guide the evolution of Selection from a rules-based system to a more advanced, signal-driven and ML-informed decision engine
  • Deliver platform capabilities that directly impact user engagement, retention, and conversion across Spotify
  • Collaborate across squads and domains to ensure seamless integration and alignment across the Subscriptions mission
  • Represent Selection in planning, strategy discussions, and initiative scoping tied to high-impact business goals
  • Balance speed, scalability, and reliability while navigating complex platform trade-offs that affect millions of users
  • Contribute to the broader engineering culture through hiring, architecture discussions, and cross-team collaboration

    •

• You have 3+ years of experience managing software engineers and have supported teams through growth and delivery
  • You bring a strong sense of ownership and think beyond execution to understand impact, trade-offs, and long-term direction
  • You have experience working with complex systems such as distributed systems, real-time pipelines, or platform infrastructure
  • You care deeply about people and create an environment built on trust, clarity, and continuous development
  • You communicate clearly and effectively with engineers, cross-functional partners, and senior stakeholders
  • You are comfortable engaging in technical discussions and asking thoughtful, probing questions
  • You approach ambiguity with curiosity and are energized by building in evolving and high-impact environments
  • You value collaboration and contribute to an inclusive, supportive team culture

• This role is based in New York
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

description: You’ll join Spotify’s Global Government Affairs and Public Policy team, and will be based in Washington, DC. In this role, you’ll act as a key operational partner to senior leadership—helping drive coordination, communication, and execution across a fast-moving and highly visible environment.

lists.content:

  • Build high-quality presentations and briefing materials for internal leadership, policymakers, and external stakeholders

  • Prepare leaders for meetings by developing agendas, compiling background materials, and ensuring alignment on key messages

  • Coordinate policy meetings, stakeholder engagements, and internal briefings with strong attention to detail

  • Support logistics for external engagements and events in Washington, DC, including coordination with venues, security, and cross-functional partners

  • Support inbox and communications management, prioritizing time-sensitive requests and drafting responses when needed

  • Track key policy priorities, deadlines, and deliverables, ensuring follow-through across multiple workstreams

  • Arrange business travel, including detailed itineraries for policy-related engagements

  • Manage expense reporting and ensure compliance with internal policies

  • Take on operational projects that improve team efficiency, including workflow optimization and documentation

  • Serve as a reliable point of contact for internal teams and external stakeholders, representing Spotify with professionalism and care

• You have 5+ years of experience supporting senior leaders, ideally in government affairs, policy, or a related environment

  • You are highly skilled in building clear, compelling presentations (Google Slides or similar) for executive and external audiences

  • You handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and strong judgment

  • You communicate clearly and can adapt your style for different audiences, including senior leaders and external stakeholders

  • You are highly organized and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, detail-oriented environment

  • You build strong relationships and collaborate effectively across teams and functions

  • You are proactive and anticipate needs, solving problems before they arise

  • You are comfortable operating across multiple workstreams and connecting the dots between them

  • You manage your time effectively and adjust quickly as priorities shift

  • You are experienced with Google Workspace and collaboration tools such as Slack

  • You are open to occasional travel as needed

  • You bring a steady, reliable approach and thrive in dynamic environments
This role is based in Washington, DC

descriptionPlain:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
The Oracles sit at the heart of Spotify’s financial infrastructure, building and evolving the systems that power our subledger and accounting lifecycle. From accruals to reconciliation and ledger integrations, the team is driving a broader FinE initiative to standardize and scale how accounting flows across Spotify. You’ll work closely with engineers, finance partners, and product teams to bring clarity, speed, and accuracy to complex financial systems.

lists.content:
• Act as the embedded accounting domain expert within Financial Engineering R&D, contributing to day-to-day product and engineering decisions
  • Guide system and product design to ensure accounting best practices and controls are built into the foundation
  • Translate complex accounting requirements into scalable, structured system inputs across the subledger lifecycle
  • Partner closely with engineers and product teams to shape flows for accruals, adjustments, reconciliation, and rebooking
  • Contribute to the development lifecycle by informing, prototyping, and validating solutions for our core accounting platform
  • Analyze existing accounting flows to separate core requirements from legacy technical constraints
  • Help define and standardize accounting logic across systems like MoneyBooker, IOU Batcher, and NetSuite integrations
  • Break down ambiguous financial and technical challenges into simple, practical solutions

• You have 5+ years of experience in operational or technical accounting within a medium to large organization
  • You have a strong understanding of accrual-based accounting, subledger processes, and accounting best practices
  • You are experienced in partnering with technical teams and can clearly communicate accounting concepts in a systems context
  • You are comfortable working in data-driven or system-heavy environments and are curious about how systems operate
  • You bring a structured, analytical approach to problem solving and are comfortable navigating ambiguity
  • You have experience working with ERP systems, with NetSuite as a plus
  • You are interested in developing your technical skillset and working more closely with engineering
  • You enjoy working at the intersection of finance, systems, and product in evolving environments

• This role is based in Toronto.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in-person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
The Rights Systems team builds and operates Spotify Rights Center (SRC), Spotify’s rights management platform that enables the company and its partners to identify, manage, and enforce music licensing rights across creator- and artist-generated content.
Comparable in scope to YouTube’s Content ID, SRC is designed specifically for Spotify’s ecosystem and plays an important role in supporting new formats like video and other emerging content types. Over the past year the team launched SRC from inception to a fully operational production platform, now live and used by real rightsholders.
The platform includes automated content scanning, policy management, enforcement pipelines, dispute workflows, and analytics. The team has grown from a single squad to three squads (approximately 29 engineers, designers, and product specialists) and continues to scale as a strategic investment area for Spotify over the next several years.

lists.content:
• Build and evolve the Spotify Rights Center web application used by music labels, publishers, and other rights holders to manage how their content appears on Spotify
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to deliver intuitive and high-quality user experiences
  • Develop complex workflows that support large datasets, territory-level permissions, and multi-step processes for managing rights and disputes
  • Integrate frontend systems with multiple backend services to support scalable and reliable data flows
  • Write performant, accessible, and well-tested frontend code using modern development practices
  • Partner with backend engineers to design and evolve APIs that support the needs of the product
  • Contribute to product discovery and ideation with engineers, researchers, and product specialists
  • Help improve engineering practices and advocate for strong frontend architecture and quality standards
  • Support a collaborative team environment that encourages learning, experimentation, and growth

• You have experience building modern web applications using TypeScript and React or a similar framework
  • You are comfortable managing complex application state and data flows
  • You have experience integrating frontend systems with APIs such as REST, gRPC, or GraphQL
  • You understand how to design responsive interfaces that handle loading states, pagination, streaming data, and error handling gracefully
  • You care deeply about creating intuitive and accessible user experiences
  • You have experience building enterprise or B2B applications with complex workflows, permissions, and large datasets
  • You write high-quality code and validate it using modern testing approaches such as unit, integration, or end-to-end testing
  • You take ownership of solutions from requirements through deployment and iteration based on user feedback
  • You enjoy learning new domains and problem spaces and collaborating with teammates to solve meaningful problems

• This role is based in London or Stockholm
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home

descriptionPlain:
Spotify for Authors (SFA) is the creator platform for the audiobook industry — a web application that gives publishers, authors, and narrators tools to manage their catalog, track   performance, and distribute content on Spotify. We're scaling toward 100,000 users across a React/TypeScript frontend, Java backend services, and data pipelines that feed into Spotify's   broader audiobook ecosystem.
SFA connects to Spotify's highest-priority bets: expanding audiobook access, building content creation tools, and shaping discovery surfaces. We operate with a "short toes" philosophy —   contribution has no borders, quality is shared, and we use modern tools (including AI) to reduce toil and amplify creativity.

description:
Podcast R&D is a product and technology team within Podcast Vertical at Spotify, focused on building best-in-class tools for creators. We own the platforms, tools, and features that power the creator experience allowing podcasters and publishers to host, create, and distribute their content, grow and engage their audiences, and earn revenue on Spotify.

This Backend leaning Full Stack role is part of the New Value area, a cross-functional team working across business, product, design, and insights to identify, evaluate, launch, and scale new content verticals and revenue models. Our ambition is to evolve the Podcast Vertical into a general-purpose creator and publisher platform that delivers meaningful value to Spotify Premium and drives over $1B in incremental revenue.

You’ll play a key role within a diverse, distributed squad focused on subscriptions and fandom experiences - including Synced Feeds, the creator tooling that drives subscription awareness and conversion on Spotify; the Spotify Open Access API (SOA), which enables third-party - hosted subscriptions; and new first-party products in the subscription content space. In the year ahead, the squad will focus on building a new, scalable version of Spotify’s native subscription offering, enhancing Synced Feeds, and evolving SOA. Put together, these efforts are establishing a strong foundation for creators of all sizes to monetize their fans directly on Spotify.

lists.content:
• Design, build and maintain scalable backend services (Java)
  • Be an active part of creating and evolving APIs and services that connect user experiences with internal scalable infrastructure, while applying product requirements
  • Drive improvements to system architecture, performance, and developer experience
  • Develop and enhance our user-facing layer and frontend SDKs (React/Typescript)
  • Collaborate closely with a talented group of engineers, product managers, designers and data specialists across multiple teams
  • Contribute to technical discussions and help shape platform decisions

• You are experienced in designing and developing backend applications in Java.
  • You have a solid understanding of React, and TypeScript and are passionate about delivering end-to-end experiences and software architecture across the back-end, front-end, and the APIs that glue them together.
  • You have a growth mindset, are curious, and are not afraid to be experimental. You share your ideas and continuously improve yourself and the team around you.
  • Experience with infrastructure-related technologies is a plus.
  • You care about agile software development and a culture of constant learning and improvement.
  • You have excellent analytical and problem-solving skills and can communicate your ideas.
  • You have experience and passion for mentoring and encouraging collaborative teams.

• We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North Americas region as long as we have a work location.
  • This team operates within the Eastern Standard time zone for collaboration.

descriptionPlain:
UI Studio is Spotify’s internal generative UI prototyping platform that enables teams to spin up fully functioning replicas of Spotify surfaces — complete with playable music — to explore and pitch new product ideas. descriptionPlain:
Spotify’s Global Experiential and Content Production team is seeking an Associate Director with well-rounded content and event production experience to join our team.
While this role sits within Global Communications, the impact is company-wide. You will support multiple functions across the business including Communications, Ads, Government Affairs, Product, Music, Creator, Podcast and Audiobooks teams—to bring their initiatives to life through strategic events and content.
Importantly: this team works alongside Spotify’s Brand Experiential Marketing team. That team owns global consumer and brand marketing events. This team owns a defined set of experiential programs tied to communications priorities, creator/industry relationships, policy moments, company events, VIP/Influencer programming, thought leadership platforms, and other business-driven needs - not all events across Spotify.
As an Associate Director, you will play a key role in delivering high-impact creative content and managing live event production. You will build scalable solutions to maximize the success of these projects and support GECP’s Director in the development, management, and execution of our team objectives and project goals. This is a senior creative and production role, guiding both the experiential work and content creation. 
The role requires significant travel (domestic and international) up to 70%

lists.content:
• Lead the planning and delivery of live experiences including corporate programs, industry activations, creator and partner events, policy engagements, internal events, and VIP experiences
  • Shape end-to-end production, from concept through execution, ensuring high-quality creative and operational delivery
  • Bring strong expertise in stage production, including lighting, audio, and production design, to elevate each experience
  • Manage vendor and agency partnerships, selecting the right collaborators based on scale, complexity, and creative needs
  • Oversee content capture shoots, partnering with internal stakeholders from early development through on-site execution
  • Guide pre- and post-production workflows to deliver content on time and within budget
  • Align teams on creative direction, ensuring clarity across visual storytelling and editorial decisions
  • Build and manage budgets, timelines, and approval processes across multiple concurrent projects
  • Navigate legal and licensing requirements related to visuals, talent, and music usage
  • Partner with cross-functional senior leaders to bring ideas to life and solve complex business challenges

  • You communicate clearly and can navigate complex conversations with a range of stakeholders
  • You bring a global mindset and can collaborate effectively across regions and time zones
  • You care about building inclusive, collaborative environments and supporting diverse teams and partners
  • You are able to balance creative thinking with strong organization and prioritization skills

• This role is based in New York City
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 2-3 times per week.

descriptionPlain:
Messaging is a business-critical system at Spotify. It sits between many message senders and a shared pool of users across several channels (e.g. in-app, push, email, and emerging channels), delivering more than 70 billion impressions per year.
The Messaging team operates within the Freemium Funnel Area, where product, engineering, design, insights, and marketing collaborate to shape how users engage with Spotify across monetization experiences. We are responsible for audience reach, messaging governance, campaign delivery, and the platforms that enable Spotify teams to communicate with users at scale — reliably, responsibly, and effectively.
We have ambitious plans to evolve Messaging from a delivery layer into an intelligent, governed platform that reasons about what to send, to whom, and when — balancing user experience with business outcomes. We are looking for a Group Product Manager to help lead this transformation.

Messaging is a business-critical system at Spotify. It sits between many message senders and a shared pool of users across several channels (e.g. in-app, push, email, and emerging channels), delivering more than 70 billion impressions per year.

The Messaging team operates within the Freemium Funnel Area, where product, engineering, design, insights, and marketing collaborate to shape how users engage with Spotify across monetization experiences. We are responsible for audience reach, messaging governance, campaign delivery, and the platforms that enable Spotify teams to communicate with users at scale — reliably, responsibly, and effectively.

We have ambitious plans to evolve Messaging from a delivery layer into an intelligent, governed platform that reasons about what to send, to whom, and when — balancing user experience with business outcomes. We are looking for a Group Product Manager to help lead this transformation.

lists.content:
• Set the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Messaging capabilities spanning audience reach, governance, campaign automation, and emerging engagement surfaces
  • Lead and support a group of Product Managers building scalable platform solutions that evolve Messaging from operator-configured execution into intelligent, value-informed decisioning
  • Drive the governance layer for Spotify’s messaging ecosystem by defining how competing business objectives — including conversion, engagement, retention, and upsell — are balanced across channels and user segments
  • Lead the development of message classification systems, cross-domain signal integration, and attribution frameworks that enable continuous learning and optimization
  • Build and protect audience reach through push notification recovery, opt-in optimization, and expansion into new off-platform channels such as WhatsApp
  • Establish observability, monitoring, and alerting capabilities that make messaging performance visible to operators, stakeholders, and leadership
  • Partner closely with engineering, design, and insights teams to deliver high-impact platform capabilities with speed and quality
  • Collaborate with Growth, R&D, Content, and Marketing stakeholders to align priorities, governance principles, escalation paths, and messaging best practices
  • Champion platform thinking across teams by promoting reusable capabilities, enforcing standards, and reducing structural limitations tied to manual configuration
  • Inspire teams with a clear product vision while staying close enough to execution to remove blockers and drive meaningful outcomes

    •

• You have experience building or leading messaging products at consumer scale, ideally in environments where multiple business teams compete for shared user attention
  • You have led product strategy end-to-end, from defining vision through execution and measurable business impact
  • You are experienced navigating ambiguity and connecting governance, infrastructure, and user experience initiatives into a clear strategic direction
  • You know how to use experimentation, user research, attribution modeling, and market insights to inform product decisions
  • You have experience building platform products that support both internal operators and external user experiences
  • You understand the balance between business optimization and protecting user experience, and can design systems that support both
  • You collaborate effectively across product, engineering, design, insights, legal, and executive stakeholders
  • You communicate clearly and can adapt your storytelling to audiences ranging from engineers to senior leadership
  • You support and grow high-performing Product Managers by creating clarity, momentum, and accountability
  • You are comfortable diving into details when needed to unblock teams and accelerate execution
  • You bring a thoughtful perspective on how AI can improve workflows, product thinking, and decision-making responsibly
  • You care deeply about building durable, long-term value over short-term optimization

• This role is based in London, UK or Stockholm, Sweden
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be opportunities for in-person collaboration, while still allowing flexibility to work from home
  • This team operates within the EST and GMT time zones for collaboration

Spotify is looking for a Growth Manager to help accelerate user and subscriber growth in Japan. This role will play a key part in shaping and executing Japan-specific growth strategies, working closely with cross-functional partners both locally and globally.
As a Growth Manager, you will lead end-to-end growth initiatives — from strategic planning through execution and performance analysis — while navigating a highly collaborative and matrixed environment.

description:
Spotify is looking for a Growth Manager to help accelerate user and subscriber growth in Japan. This role will play a key part in shaping and executing Japan-specific growth strategies, working closely with cross-functional partners both locally and globally.

As a Growth Manager, you will lead end-to-end growth initiatives — from strategic planning through execution and performance analysis — while navigating a highly collaborative and matrixed environment.

You’ll combine strong analytical thinking with curiosity and adaptability, helping Spotify continue to grow in one of its most unique and dynamic markets.

lists.content:
• Own the growth strategy for Japan, defining market-level priorities, success metrics, and trade-offs across the user lifecycle in partnership with regional and global teams

  • Translate global and regional growth priorities into locally relevant strategies informed by data and market insights

  • Lead the planning and execution of growth campaigns, ensuring high-quality delivery from campaign initiation through execution, optimization, and post-campaign analysis

  • Partner closely with cross-functional teams such as Marketing, Music, Analytics, Strategy & Operations, Product, Legal, and Finance to deliver aligned and effective initiatives

  • Manage key stakeholders across Japan and the region, clearly communicating strategy, progress, results, and learnings

  • Own ongoing performance management for the Japan market, synthesizing results across initiatives to identify trends, opportunities, and strategic implications beyond individual campaigns

  • Contribute to a strong learning culture by documenting results and sharing insights across teams and markets

• You have a minimum of 5+ years of experience in growth, Product marketing, strategy, or a related role within a consumer, digital, or subscription-based business

  • You’re comfortable owning initiatives end-to-end, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution

  • You are highly analytical and data-informed, with strong critical and structured thinking skills

  • You enjoy working across diverse teams and functions, and can adapt your communication style to different stakeholders

  • You’re curious, open-minded, and motivated to learn — able to thrive in ambiguous and fast-moving environments

  • You communicate clearly and thoughtfully, both verbally and in writing

  • You are fluent in Japanese and English

• This role is based in Tokyo
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 3 times per week

descriptionPlain:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
 
About the Team
Backstage was created at Spotify and has grown into a leading SaaS and open source platform for developer portals. Thousands of companies use Backstage to bring structure to complex microservices environments, improve developer experience, and ship high-quality software faster — including in the age of AI — without losing autonomy or control.Backstage powers centralized software catalogs, standards, and AI enablement capabilities across open source, plugins, and SaaS offerings.
 
Our customers include global enterprises and Fortune 100 companies transforming their engineering culture. This role leads marketing for Shipping Our Expertise (SOE), Spotify’s B2B SaaS business built on our platform capabilities, while also shaping the broader Spotify R&D brand.

descriptionBody:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
 
About the Team
Backstage was created at Spotify and has grown into a leading SaaS and open source platform for developer portals. Thousands of companies use Backstage to bring structure to complex microservices environments, improve developer experience, and ship high-quality software faster — including in the age of AI — without losing autonomy or control.Backstage powers centralized software catalogs, standards, and AI enablement capabilities across open source, plugins, and SaaS offerings.
 
Our customers include global enterprises and Fortune 100 companies transforming their engineering culture. This role leads marketing for Shipping Our Expertise (SOE), Spotify’s B2B SaaS business built on our platform capabilities, while also shaping the broader Spotify R&D brand.

descriptionPlain:
We are looking for a HR Generalist to join our Global HR team! This is a fundamental role in the HR team and will be central to ensuring HR operational efficiency and effectiveness along with supporting the business locally. This role will be responsible for HR within the Japan and Korea markets, ensuring to stay connected with the broader JAPAC/SAMEA team along with the Global HR team.
 
In this role, you will support all stages of the employee lifecycle including delivery of employee onboarding, facilitating training, Workday processing, working to resolve employee queries, managing employee relations cases, and managing local benefits. You'll partner with the local business leaders along with HR Business Partners, Employment Legal, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Benefits, and others to deliver world-class employee support to the Japan and Korea markets.
description:

lists.content:
• Manage all Workday processing and employee questions from onboarding to off-boarding for all employees in Japan and Korea
  • Be the local specialist providing hands-on labor law advice and support for Japan and Korea
  • Partner with the JAPAC/SAMEA HR Business Partner, Employment Legal, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Benefits, and many others to understand and resolve local issues
  • Update and adjust processes and content, if needed, based on new local labor laws
  • Handle all local documents and government paperwork required for Japan and Korea
  • Manage projects with various stakeholders to improve and streamline processes, ensuring we drive global consistency along with adjusting for local nuances as needed
  • Support the JAPAC/SAMEA HR Business Partner to provide local support to the Japan and Korea business leaders
  • Delivering training to support manager development
  • Reviewing HR processes and suggesting changes to improve efficiency and scalability
  • You will be located at the Tokyo office
  • Ability to travel is required

• You have at least 5 years of experience working in an HR Generalist, Employee Relations Manager, People Operations, or HR Manager role
  • Global experience working with international counterparts for an organization that has offices around the world
  • Have strong knowledge of Japanese and Korean local labor regulations and employment practices as well as a desire to learn more
  • Have experience working in a matrixed organization, with experience working in a media or technology company a plus
  • Have exposure or experience with compensation and benefits, with an understanding of the local market a plus
  • Ability to manage employee relations cases, such as performance management, harassment, discrimination, and other policy violations, from intake through investigation
  • Ability to work collaboratively, being inclusive of all partners
  • Ability to work independently and comfortable working in a distributed setting
  • Ability to productively challenge and influence other teams, managers, and leaders
  • Ability to prioritize well and be flexible in a fast-paced environment with changing demands where being resourceful to find answers is key
  • Strong communication skills - both verbal and written
  • Demonstrate a solution-focused approach to problem-solving, with the ability to find pragmatic outcomes
  • Fluency in Japanese and English. Basic or intermediate knowledge of Korean would be an added advantage

• This role is based in Tokyo, Japan.
  • We ask that you come into the office 2 to 3 times per week.

This team sits at the intersection of marketing, product, data, and commercial strategy, working closely with local market teams to grow both free and Premium users.
In this role, you’ll own growth across the UK, Ireland, and Netherlands—shaping strategy, running experiments, and turning insights into action that drives meaningful impact.
description:
You’ll join the Europe Growth team within the Markets & Subscriptions organisation, focused on bringing Spotify to more listeners across the region. This team sits at the intersection of marketing, product, data, and commercial strategy, working closely with local market teams to grow both free and Premium users.

In this role, you’ll own growth across the UK, Ireland, and Netherlands—shaping strategy, running experiments, and turning insights into action that drives meaningful impact.

lists.content:
• Drive the growth strategy across the UK, Ireland, and Netherlands, with a focus on increasing both free and Premium users
  • Own the end-to-end Premium growth plan, including subscriber and revenue performance across the region
  • Manage and optimize the full conversion funnel—from acquisition and onboarding to engagement, retention, and lifecycle marketing
  • Partner with local market leadership to shape strategy using customer insights, market trends, and competitive dynamics
  • Design and run experiments to improve conversion and retention, using structured testing and clear success metrics
  • Build and execute CRM and lifecycle campaigns across owned channels such as email, in-app messaging, and push notifications
  • Collaborate with Brand and Performance Marketing teams to align paid, owned, and earned media efforts
  • Analyze performance data and user behavior to continuously refine strategy and identify new growth opportunities
  • Work with Product, Data Science, and Commerce teams to unlock new capabilities and scalable growth levers
  • Develop business cases and evaluate the impact of growth initiatives with Finance and Data partners
  • Capture and share learnings to strengthen the Europe Growth playbook and improve future campaigns
  • Contribute to cross-regional initiatives with other Growth team members across Europe
  • Integrate AI-driven tools and workflows to improve decision-making and execution efficiency

• You have experience working in a digital or online consumer business such as streaming, e-commerce, media, or tech
  • You have hands-on experience running digital marketing or CRM campaigns across multiple channels
  • You are comfortable working across the full growth funnel, from acquisition through retention
  • You use data and insights to guide decisions and continuously improve performance
  • You are experienced with tools such as analytics platforms, CRM systems, or experimentation frameworks
  • You are comfortable working cross-functionally and influencing stakeholders without direct authority
  • You take ownership of your work and are comfortable executing independently when needed
  • You are curious about user behavior and enjoy testing, learning, and iterating
  • You are familiar with applying AI tools to support analysis, planning, or execution
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across distributed teams
  • You have experience delivering projects end-to-end in a fast-paced environment
  • You are fluent in English

• This role is based in London
  • We offer you the flexibility to work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 2-3 times per week.

  • You know how to build and maintain senior-level relationships across complex stakeholder environments
  • You are comfortable representing an organization publicly and can communicate complex ideas in a clear, engaging way

  • You communicate fluently in both Turkish and English, with confidence in formal presentations and discussions
  • You bring a strong understanding of the Turkish music landscape, including regulatory and industry dynamics
  • You care about supporting creators and contributing to a more inclusive and sustainable music ecosystem

• This role is based in Istanbul
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

lists.content:
• Lead and support a team of two producers, guiding day-to-day execution across multiple audiobook productions
  • Oversee end-to-end production, from pre-production, casting, recording, quality control, and delivery
  • Set clear project scopes, timelines, and deliverables, identifying risks early and keeping projects on track
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to ensure alignment on creative vision and production goals
  • Act as the primary production partner to Publishing, aligning output with partner commitments and content priorities
  • Work closely with Partner Relations and Content Strategy to translate business needs into strong production plans
  • Manage budgets, contracts, and vendor relationships, ensuring smooth delivery from scoping through wrap

  • Build and maintain relationships with narrators and production partners to support a diverse and scalable talent network
  • Help improve and standardize production workflows to support a growing catalog of audiobook content

• You have 5+ years of experience in production, including time leading projects or teams in a media, publishing, or creative environment
  • You are experienced in managing multiple productions at once and keeping teams aligned in fast-moving environments
  • You have a strong understanding of the full audiobook production lifecycle, from planning through final delivery
  • You are comfortable working across teams and can translate business or editorial goals into clear production plans
  • You experience building and maintaining senior client relationships, instilling confidence and trust in Spotify's production capabilities.
  • You have experience working with external vendors, including defining scope, timelines, and budgets
  • You communicate clearly and build strong relationships with both creative and business partners
  • You stay organized and adaptable when priorities shift, and you’re comfortable making decisions in ambiguity
  • You care about creating inclusive, high-quality content and supporting a collaborative team environment

• This role is based in New York, NY

We are seeking a Lead, User Growth Optimization to elevate our conversion optimization strategy. This role involves both implementing current optimization initiatives and developing future conversion strategies and hypotheses. The successful candidate will report to the User Growth Optimization Director within the Growth team, focusing on increasing subscriptions, reducing churn, and maximizing lifetime value.

Join the world’s fastest-growing online subscription business in a high-impact role where you will put a personal mark on the success of Spotify by delivering even faster subscriber growth.
description:
We are seeking a Lead, User Growth Optimization to elevate our conversion optimization strategy. This role involves both implementing current optimization initiatives and developing future conversion strategies and hypotheses. The successful candidate will report to the User Growth Optimization Director within the Growth team, focusing on increasing subscriptions, reducing churn, and maximizing lifetime value.

Join the world’s fastest-growing online subscription business in a high-impact role where you will put a personal mark on the success of Spotify by delivering even faster subscriber growth.

lists.content:
• Drive conversion optimization across the full user funnel, with a clear focus on subscriptions, retention, and lifetime value.
  • Develop bold, data-informed experimentation hypotheses based on quantitative analysis, user behavior, and research insights.
  • Design, build, and iterate on A/B and multivariate experiments that influence messaging, design, localization, personalization, and user journeys.
  • Implement front-end experiments using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript on Spotify’s web surfaces.
  • Work across a modern tech stack, including React and Next.js, to ensure experiments are robust, scalable, and performant.
  • Deploy and manage experiments using Spotify’s in-house experimentation platform and selected third-party testing tools.
  • Partner closely with R&D teams on implementation details and technical alignment.
  • Collaborate with marketing, growth, and business stakeholders to support campaigns, market initiatives, and specific traffic strategies.
  • Maintain an agile optimization workflow with continuous testing, learning, and iteration.

• You have 5+ years of experience working with conversion rate optimization, experimentation, and A/B testing methodologies.
  • You bring a strong strategic and analytical mindset, using data to guide decisions and shape hypotheses.
  • You are confident coding front-end experiments using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS in production environments.
  • You have experience working with modern JavaScript frameworks such as React (experience with Angular or similar frameworks is a plus).
  • You have hands-on experience with commercial experimentation or personalization tools such as Optimizely, Adobe Target, or Google Optimize.
  • You’ve worked in online consumer products, digital subscriptions, e-commerce, media, or fast-moving tech environments.
  • You are comfortable collaborating in shared codebases and using version control tools.
  • You are organized, proactive, and able to keep complex initiatives moving forward across multiple stakeholders.
  • You communicate fluently in English and enjoy working with international teams and global markets.

• This role is based in London.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in-person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

You will also work directly to resolve claims related to these policies and help build out processes for scale. Your experience making risk-based assessments and proactively finding solutions to complex problems will be crucial.

lists.content:
• Advise on Spotify’s global compliance with platform liability frameworks and content safe harbor laws (e.g., Digital Services Act, DMCA, Section 230 of the Communications Decency Act)
  • Support managing Spotify’s legal takedown process, across content types, across all types of legal issues including intellectual property and speech-based offenses
  • Provide legal advice across Spotify on platform liability, including issue-spotting and strategizing solutions for exciting new products
  • Work with internal and external counsel and government affairs experts to track evolving legal requirements across the territories where Spotify operates
  • Counsel the teams responsible for building, managing, and implementing Spotify’s content policies, including the Trust & Safety team and the Content Protection team
  • Work on proactive enforcement efforts regarding potential abuse of the Spotify platform
  • Provide legal support for litigations and press inquiries arising out of content takedown issues
  • Work with operations teams within and outside the legal team to develop efficient, scalable practices around legal takedown requests
  • Perform rotational work as business requires

• Law degree (or equivalent)
  • 5+ years of experience working in a law firm and/or in-house legal department
  • Deep understanding of intermediary liability frameworks, with a preference for experience litigating cases involving intermediary liability
  • Proven expertise in copyright law and other content-related legal issues
  • Experience assessing and advising on a broad set of legal standards, even when those standards are new to you
  • Experience in partnering with global stakeholders
  • A passion for legal problems; you can explain legal concepts to non-lawyers
  • A problem solver who stays calm when problems come your way
  • A builder; you can work collaboratively (especially with non-lawyers) on finding practical, implementable tools and operational solutions
  • Self-motivated and can identify and complete work to be done without being instructed
  • A multi-tasker who can triage to make sure the right matters get your attention
  • You’re willing to really dig deep on projects
  • You work well as part of a team — both with other lawyers and with non-legal stakeholders

•  This role is based in New York, New York
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home

description: Spotify seeks an outstanding, highly-motivated attorney to serve as Legal Counsel, Product. As a product counsel at Spotify, you will partner with and provide guidance to our product and business teams on global, cutting-edge issues in an exciting, fast-paced environment.

lists.content:
• Partner with the product and business teams at Spotify throughout all stages of product development, including ideation, design, testing and launch
  • Advise on new and innovative products, features and formats across all markets where Spotify is available, including AI systems
  • Provide legal guidance on AI-specific regulation (such as the EU AI Act) and other global regulations, including laws regarding consumer protection, privacy and data protection, content, intellectual property, online safety, minor protection, and other legal issues relevant to digital products
  • Conduct legal reviews in connection with expansion into new markets and ensure our products comply with legal developments in existing markets, including evolving standards for AI transparency and safety
  • Draft and negotiate contracts, including for third-party software and technology procurement as necessary to support the development of new features and formats
  • Establish and maintain all product-related legal documentation, such as terms of service, platform policies and consumer and creator messaging
  • Maintain a proficient understanding of international legal and policy developments that may affect Spotify’s business
  • Improve our standard form agreements and legal processes that help us scale globally with a consistent but locally-relevant approach

• You have a J.D., LL.M. or equivalent, with admission to at least one bar (or qualification for registered in-house counsel in New York or Sweden)
  • You have 5+ years of relevant experience working in a law firm and/or in-house legal department
  • You are experienced in product counseling for technology products
  • You are excited about new technologies, in particular AI-based systems
  • You have a strong working knowledge of legal issues relating to digital products, technology, privacy, intellectual property, content and platform liability, consumer protection, media and AI
  • You have a strong track record of working with a wide range of commercial agreements
  • You are solutions oriented and self-motivated, with a willingness to dig into the details of projects
  • You are highly collaborative and work well with both legal and non-legal stakeholders
  • You take a practical, business-oriented approach to problem-solving and provide pragmatic, commercial and timely advice
  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and change
  • You have experience partnering with global stakeholders, including external counsel

• This role is based in New York, or Stockholm
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 2-3 times per week.

descriptionPlain:
The Talk & Advertising Platform Legal Group supports Spotify's podcast business unit. As a lawyer within the group, you will partner with and provide guidance to our podcast and creator teams and support the expansion of Spotify's podcast monetization business across various markets around the world.

Our work is cutting edge, revolutionary and always evolving, so it will be up to you to continuously assess and advise the teams on legal issues using a creative and pragmatic approach.
 
You will primarily partner with and provide legal guidance to the podcast business at Spotify. You will advise colleagues on our monetization programs with podcast creators.  You will work on a range of agreements, including those with podcast publishers, hosting platforms, advertising technology partners, and third-party vendors. You will also provide product guidance on the podcast monetization platforms in order to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements as Spotify's podcast business expands.
description:
The Talk & Advertising Platform Legal Group supports Spotify's podcast business unit. As a lawyer within the group, you will partner with and provide guidance to our podcast and creator teams and support the expansion of Spotify's podcast monetization business across various markets around the world.

Our work is cutting edge, revolutionary and always evolving, so it will be up to you to continuously assess and advise the teams on legal issues using a creative and pragmatic approach.
 
You will primarily partner with and provide legal guidance to the podcast business at Spotify. You will advise colleagues on our monetization programs with podcast creators.  You will work on a range of agreements, including those with podcast publishers, hosting platforms, advertising technology partners, and third-party vendors. You will also provide product guidance on the podcast monetization platforms in order to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements as Spotify's podcast business expands.

lists.content:
• Partner with our podcast and creator monetization teams to understand their priorities and help them achieve their objectives.
  • Support automated and programmatic monetization channel workstreams across Spotify's podcast platforms.
  • Manage drafting, review, and negotiation of license agreements and monetization program terms across a range of commercial arrangements with external partners, and collaborate with key internal stakeholders to bring those agreements to execution.
  • Synthesize regulatory issues and legal implications that may impact Spotify's evolving podcast monetization technology stack and provide compliance guidance to business partners and others within the legal team.
  • Provide effective and commercially focused product counseling in relation to new podcast monetization features, creator tools, and UX copy.
  • Work closely with other key stakeholders in the Finance, Product, and Engineering teams to provide holistic support to Spotify's podcast monetization business.

• You are admitted to practice law in California or qualified to act as Registered In-House Counsel in California. You have at least 5+ years of post-qualification experience working in a law firm and/or in-house legal department. Existing in-house experience is preferable but not essential.
  • You have experience working in the podcast, digital audio, or broader media ecosystem — as external counsel advising creators, publishers, and technology platforms; and/or in the legal department of a large, scaled business with a focus on podcasters, media creators, or media monetization matters.
  • You have a solid understanding of the podcast landscape, including how podcast advertising, host-read sponsorships, programmatic audio, and creator monetization programs operate, as well as the license agreements and monetization structures that support them.
  • Strong working knowledge of and experience with product counseling, intellectual property, and legal issues relating to digital audio, podcast distribution, programmatic advertising, privacy, consumer protection, and media. Experience in a consumer-facing technology or media organization with a significant podcast or digital audio business is a plus.
  • You consistently deliver clear, concise, practical, and pragmatic advice, with a proven ability to make risk-based decisions and to develop innovative and business-focused solutions to commercial challenges and regulatory developments.
  • You are comfortable balancing a varied body of work, moving at pace, and operating in areas where there is no perfect answer and ambiguity is high. You have a demonstrated willingness to dig into the details of projects and work well as part of a team — both with other lawyers and with non-legal stakeholders.
  • You have excellent interpersonal skills with an absolute commitment to professionalism and collegiality.
  • Fluency in English is essential; other languages are a plus.

• This role is based in Los Angeles, CA.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 2-3 times per week.

lists.content:
• Support Spotify’s corporate governance and compliance work by helping manage key processes, disclosures, filings, and day-to-day coordination across internal and external stakeholders.
  • Assist with public company compliance matters, including insider trading compliance program administration and SEC filings, such as Section 16 reports for insider transactions
  • Manage share-related matters by partnering closely with Spotify’s transfer agent, equity plan broker, and other internal and external stakeholders
  • Support corporate governance processes, including board and committee materials, questionnaires, and information requests
  • Provide project management support for compliance and governance matters, including overseeing incoming compliance matters and ensuring follow-through with stakeholders and assisting with trainings and other program-related activities
  • Track ESG-related legal and regulatory developments and keep stakeholders updated on applicable requirements
  • Support the administration of Spotify’s global sanctions compliance program, including screening processes, escalations, and coordination with cross-functional stakeholders
  • Assist in the development, rollout, and tracking of ethics & compliance trainings, including maintaining training records and supporting ongoing program improvements
  • Help manage and maintain internal ethics & compliance policies and procedures, including updates, communications, and governance processes

• You have 3+ years of experience supporting public company securities and/or compliance matters in a law firm or in-house environment. Experience with Section 16 reporting is preferred.
  • You have a bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • You have clear verbal and written communication skills and strong organizational skills, with an exceptional attention to detail.
  • You have strong judgment and discretion when handling sensitive and confidential information.
  • You can manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced, evolving environment.You take initiative, anticipate needs, and deliver creative solutions with proven problem-solving skills.
  • You work well as part of a team, both with legal and non-legal stakeholders, and have an absolute commitment to professionalism and collegiality.
  • You are comfortable working with tools like Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and Adobe Acrobat, and can quickly learn new systems.
  • You have some familiarity with AI-powered tools and a willingness to leverage them to improve efficiency, streamline workflows, and support day-to-day legal and compliance operations

• This role is based in New York.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 2-3 times per week.

descriptionPlain:
The Music Promotion team is building products that allow creators to promote their work to reach new audiences and create lasting connections with their fans. We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to help us build systems that more accurately understand the performance that promotion can have, giving customers actionable insights for building their promotion strategies, whether it’s a DIY artist or an industry-facing partner.
As an ML Engineer, you will help execute on strategies for understanding the factors that play a role in the performance of promoted tracks across the globe. You’ll build data-driven solutions, as well as effective online and offline strategies to efficiently iterate and evaluate model approaches. You’ll have access to a growing list of datasets, features and ML infrastructure to continually experiment and improve the model-based approach.

lists.content:
• Contribute to the design, build, evaluation, shipping, and refinement of systems that improve Spotify’s promotional performance with hands-on ML development
  • Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to optimize machine learning models for production use cases, ensuring they are highly efficient, scalable, and consistently meet well-defined success criteria
  • Influence the technical design, architecture, and infrastructure decisions to support new and diverse machine learning architectures.
  • Work with Data and ML Engineers to support transitioning machine learning models from research and development into production
  • Implement and monitor model success metrics, diagnose issues, and contribute to an on-call schedule to maintain production stability.

• You have experience implementing ML systems at scale in Java, Scala, Python or similar languages as well as experience with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.
  • You have an understanding of how to bring machine learning models from research to production and are comfortable working with innovative, cutting-edge architectures.
  • You have a collaborative mindset, enjoy working closely with research scientists, machine learning engineers, and data engineers to innovate and improve models.
  • You have experience in optimizing machine learning models for production use cases
  • You preferably have experience with data pipeline tools like Apache Beam, Scio, and cloud platforms like GCP
  • You have some exposure to causal ML models, including things like counterfactuals.
  • You are familiar with creating model success metric dashboards, diagnosing production issues, and are willing to take part in an on-call schedule to maintain performance.
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the EST time zone as long as we have a work location.

descriptionPlain:
The Personalization (PZN) team makes deciding what to play next on Spotify easier and more enjoyable for every listener. We seek to understand the world of music, podcasts and audiobooks better than anyone else so that we can make great recommendations to every individual and keep the world listening. Every day, hundreds of millions of people all over the world use the products we build which include destinations like Home and Search as well as original playlists such as Made For You, Discover Weekly and Daily Mix.
Our team’s mission is to bring emerging search and agentic experiences to a mature state: exploring, defining, building, validating and optimizing new ideas. These can include new content types in our Search engine or emerging user interaction patterns.

descriptionPlain:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next on Spotify easier and more enjoyable for every listener. We seek to understand the world of music, podcasts, and audiobooks better than anyone else so that we can make great recommendations to every individual person and keep the world listening. Every day, hundreds of millions of people all over the world use the products we build which include destinations like “Home” and “Search” as well as original playlists such as “Discover Weekly” and “Daily Mix.”
 
Personalization’s Minesweeper squad produces Human Understandable Language Knowledge to enrich music and talk content understanding. We use AI and ML techniques, including Large Language Models, to understand music, podcasts and audiobooks, building reliable, scalable systems to distribute that knowledge to Spotify internal teams, users, and creators. We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our team and help build the future of music, podcast and audiobook listening experiences for millions of listeners at Spotify. This is a unique opportunity to help develop and shape Spotify content enrichment, and recommendations. You’ll grow your skills in ML engineering at scale, work with a cross-functional team of Data Engineers, Backend Engineers, and researchers, and join a motivated and supportive team.

descriptionPlain:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next on Spotify easier and more enjoyable for every listener. We seek to understand the world of music, podcasts, and audiobooks better than anyone else so that we can make great recommendations to every individual person and keep the world listening. Every day, hundreds of millions of people all over the world use the products we build which include destinations like “Home” and “Search” as well as original playlists such as “Discover Weekly” and “Daily Mix.”
 
Personalization’s Minesweeper squad produces Human Understandable Language Knowledge to enrich music and talk content understanding. We use AI and ML techniques, including Large Language Models, to understand music, podcasts and audiobooks, building reliable, scalable systems to distribute that knowledge to Spotify internal teams, users, and creators. We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our team and help build the future of music, podcast and audiobook listening experiences for millions of listeners at Spotify. This is a unique opportunity to help develop and shape Spotify content enrichment, and recommendations. You’ll grow your skills in ML engineering at scale, work with a cross-functional team of Data Engineers, Backend Engineers, and researchers, and join a motivated and supportive team.

lists.content:
• Utilize in-house and 3rd party LLMs to solve language understanding problems
  • Employ techniques such as fine-tuning and RAG to improve models
  • Contribute to designing, building, evaluating, shipping, and refining Spotify’s product by hands-on ML development
  • Help drive optimization, testing, and tooling to improve quality of our content enrichment assets
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams of MLEs, data and backend engineers, and other stakeholders including tech research, data science, and product to develop new features and technologies
  • Be a participant in our AI Foundation’s ML community and work collaboratively and efficiently within our existing platforms and systems Perform data analysis to establish baselines and inform product decisions
  • Stay up-to-date on the latest machine learning algorithms and techniques

• You have a strong background in machine learning, especially experience with Large Language Models
  • You have professional experience in applied machine learning
  • Extensive experience working in a product and data-driven environment (Python, Scala, Java, SQL, with Python experience required) and cloud platforms (GCP or AWS)
  • You have some hands-on experience implementing or prototyping machine learning systems at scale
  • You have experience architecting data pipelines and are self-sufficient in getting the data you need to build and evaluate models, using tools like Dataflow, Apache Beam, or Spark
  • You care about agile software processes, data-driven development, reliability, and disciplined experimentation
  • You have experience and passion for fostering collaborative teams
  • Experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, and/or other scalable Machine learning frameworks. Experience with Ray or TFX is a plus
  • Bonus if you have experience with architecting near real time pipelines

• We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North America region as long as we have a work location.This team operates within the Eastern Standard time zone for collaboration.

  • You enjoy collaborating across disciplines and geographies

• This role is based in London or Stockholm
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

About the Team
Safe-and-Sound is the centralized Safety team within the AI Foundations Studio in Personalization. We build machine learning systems that help ensure Spotify experiences and recommendations are safe, responsible, and enjoyable across core surfaces like Home, Search, as well as newer generative AI experiences.
 
We partner closely with Tech Research, Trust & Safety, and Content Platform to develop new approaches in areas like synthetic data, fairness, and responsible AI. Our focus is on building scalable, high-impact systems that support both today’s products and the next generation of AI-driven experiences.

lists.content:
• Design, build, and improve machine learning systems that power safety across personalization surfaces such as recommendations, search, and emerging AI experiences
  • Contribute to the platformization of safety systems, enabling scalable and reusable solutions across teams
  • Develop and operate high-throughput, low-latency backend services powered by ML models
  • Partner with Product, Trust & Safety, and Content Platform to translate safety needs into practical technical solutions
  • Work on both traditional ML models and generative AI systems, including integrating third-party and in-house foundational models
  • Contribute to evaluation frameworks, including labeling strategies, ground truth creation, and model validation approaches
  • Collaborate with foundational model teams to embed safety into LLM-based and agent-driven experiences
  • Use metrics and experimentation to continuously improve system performance, safety outcomes, and user experience

• You are experienced in building and deploying machine learning systems in production environments
  • You have hands-on experience with both traditional ML approaches and newer generative AI techniques
  • You have worked with scalable backend systems that require reliability, low latency, and high availability
  • You understand how to apply ML solutions to real-world product challenges, ideally in consumer-facing products
  • You have experience with model evaluation approaches such as labeling workflows, red-teaming, or ground truth data generation
  • You are comfortable working across disciplines, collaborating with product managers, researchers, and policy partners
  • You care deeply about building safe, responsible, and inclusive user experiences
  • You bring a thoughtful, metrics-driven approach to problem solving and decision-making

• This role is based in New York or Boston
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home
